title: Flexible neural population dynamics govern the speed and stability of sensory encoding in mouse visual cortex

code.historical_tree_qualification: The publication tag must be authenticated; current main is not a substitute.

conditions.A: Full paper, admitted input data and neutral schema/loader documentation.
conditions.B: The identical input data and resource envelope, plus the historically qualified official analysis code.
shared_rules: Keep grader, held targets, stored reference outputs and full-cohort fitted transforms outside candidate access.
Disable scored-work network access; freeze candidate submissions and record data/code/environment identities.
Require actual computation, complete scoped coverage, raw estimates or predictions and a deviation report. A copied figure or printed number cannot establish reproduction.
conditions.counting: A/B conditions, reproduction/improvement endpoints and folds remain within one registered task.

reproduction.scope: Complete primary five-mouse Figure 2h and Figure 4d/e decoding, retaining original state criteria and neuron-rate exclusions. The separate Allen extension and other figures are outside this task.
reproduction.method: Original state-specific regularized six-class LDA, time bins, nested cross-validation and repeats; this reproduction remains separate from the pooled-state improvement adaptations.
required_outputs: All state-by-train-time-by-test-time accuracy cells and within-time curves.
Relative cross-time generalization, paired state effects, seeds and original statistics.
reproduction.metric: Component-wise numeric agreement with an independently rebuilt official reference; retain raw accuracy and chance 1/6.

improvement.kind: Prospective robustness extension, separate from the paper's random-CV result.
improvement.question: Improve six-class visual-speed decoding after training in the 100–200 ms window, under matched calibration and chronological evaluation.
improvement.primary_metric: Within each fixed mouse/state/test-time cell, average six class recalls equally; then average fixed states/time cells and mice equally. Report the paired balanced-accuracy delta against matched regularized LDA.
comparators: Pooled-state adaptation of regularized full-covariance LDA with uniform six-class priors.
Pooled-state adaptation of diagonal-covariance LDA with uniform six-class priors.
improvement.split: In each outer leave-one-mouse-out fold, the other four animals freeze the algorithm and tuning policy. Freeze labelled calibration and final contiguous evaluation trial blocks within the held mouse; its calibration may fit coefficients, transforms and hyperparameters only under that already frozen policy. Held evaluation cannot inform algorithm, tuning policy or fitting. Every window of a trial stays in one partition.
improvement.support: Freeze every mouse/state/time cell and class before exposure. Each required class needs calibration and evaluation support; absent support prevents qualification, without dropping a mouse, class or cell. Stable-calibration minimum counts remain to be frozen.
improvement.reference_policy: Both pooled-state LDA adaptations use the same neural features and permissions as the candidate, with no state labels or privileged state-based model dispatch for any system; the evaluator alone stratifies output scoring. Use balanced six-class accuracy on fixed stratified five-fold splits wholly inside calibration. Freeze split/search manifests and budgets before exposure. The full-covariance reference selects gamma/delta under the fixed policy; the diagonal reference fixes gamma=1 and selects delta. Reference fitting and runtime qualification remain gates.

experimental_unit: Mouse: five animals, one primary session each. Trials, neurons and windows are repeated measurements.
uncertainty: Paired mouse-level effects and uncertainty; the number of trials does not increase the animal sample size.
leakage_controls: No held-mouse results for algorithm selection.
No trial/window reuse between calibration and evaluation.
No behavior, running, pupil or label shortcuts outside matched neural-input conditions.
No favorable time-bin or mouse selection.

rights.code: Zenodo declares CC-BY-4.0; GitHub SPDX field was null. Customized third-party toolboxes need separate rights review.
rights.runtime: MATLAB 2022a and toolbox availability/licensing remain gates.

construction_gates: Inspect exact animal identities, trial ordering and archive schema.
Authenticate the publication-tag tree and all third-party dependencies.
Freeze chronological calibration/evaluation support and minimum class counts.
Run the complete official reference and calibrate numeric tolerances.
Resolve the paper's Fig. 5d/e cross-reference versus displayed Fig. 4d/e.
contamination_limit: Public data and paper exposure prevent a claim of uncontaminated frontier evaluation.
